body:
Hi my name is Garrett but my (IGN:IAcidHD).I have recently been banned for a reason but one that was not my fault. You see i have a little brother named Gregory and he wants to get his own computer so he can play mine craft. So like a little brother would do he is always playing on my computer. so i had my mod/hacked client on for my YouTube channel so it is easier to do stuff that is why i had them on so the content would be better. But he got off my world used for YouTube and went on your server. And he joined a game and turned on fly. I am so sorry for what he did i swear I/he will never do it again. Not only that but my friend and I would like to record a video on your server. Thank you for all your time this is one of my favorite servers. Thank you and i hope you understand.   
    https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnOICYfC9sI-qoinNPNbZ4w
